summary.text: Bill Werkheiser represents Georgia House District 157, which consists of Tattnall, Evans and Wayne counties, and was elected to the House in 2014.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from Georgia Southern University in 1982 with a Bachelor of Science in Technology.
He owned and operated printing companies for more than 30 years until 2016 and also has a real estate business. He lives in Glennville.
